For Carlos Yulo, the road to gold at the Asian Games 2026 begins with silence. The two-time Paris Olympic gold medalist has gone off the grid in the days leading up to Monday’s qualification phase of the men’s artistic gymnastics competition at the Nagoya General Gymnasium Rainbow Hall.
